## Objective

Restore bounded expression property and fuzz checks.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U5`
Covers: `R1, R2, R5, R9; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.2 (U2) — Activate authoring and Covenant gates must be complete; jido-07x.3 (U3) — Port Signal property and fuzz checks must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.6 (U6) — Port Action system and load checks must be complete; jido-07x.7 (U7) — Port Action and Flow benchmark smoke checks must be complete; jido-07x.8 (U8) — Add the example catalog harness must be complete; jido-07x.10 (U10) — Port Action execution examples must be complete; jido-07x.12 (U12) — Port core basic and workflow examples must be complete.

## Files

Read `../refs/jido_action/test/property/**` at `40ec1f0af3a373bae5e6d869017cc229c85aef92`. Add `test/property/action_flow/**`. Change the manifest. Do not change `lib/**`.

## Instructions

1. Port expression tree generators, parser limits, operator checks, report support, and reduced failure handling.
2. Rename test support to current `Jido.*` ownership.
3. Keep the required fuzz case list and full-report gate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generated expression trees have explicit depth and size limits.
- [ ] Short-circuit and parser limit checks pass.
- [ ] Fuzz output records every required case.

## Verification

- `mix test.property test/property/action_flow` and `mix test.fuzz test/property/action_flow` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
